Keep final test data outside checkpoint selection and stopping-rule tuning.

labs.title: Early stopping: calculate and compare
labs.summary: Keep the best checkpoint, not merely the checkpoint where patience runs out.
labs.equation: improvement: lossₜ < best_loss − min_delta; stop when wait ≥ patience
labs.assumptions: Illustrative fixed validation losses [0.90,0.70,0.55,0.50,0.51,0.52,0.49,0.53,0.54,0.55]. Lower is better, min_delta=0, one check per epoch, and the best observed checkpoint is restored.
labs.accessibilitySummary: Early stopping. Illustrative fixed validation losses [0.90,0.70,0.55,0.50,0.51,0.52,0.49,0.53,0.54,0.55]. Lower is better, min_delta=0, one check per epoch, and the best observed checkpoint is restored. A data table and numeric summary accompany the graph.
labs.takeaway: Patience changes which later improvements the run gets a chance to observe; the best available checkpoint can occur before the stopping epoch.
